def harness_time(fn, inputs=(), outputs=(), warmup=10, rep=50, tries=3):
    """Median µs of fn(*inputs, *outputs) with the harness's CUPTI methodology (cold L2, shifted pointers)."""
    from sol_execbench.core.bench.timing import time_runnable
    for attempt in range(tries):
        try:
            ms = time_runnable(fn, list(inputs), list(outputs), "cuda:0", warmup=warmup, rep=rep,
                               return_mode="median", methodology="cupti")
            return ms * 1e3
        except ValueError as e:                          # CUPTI occasionally drops an iteration's records here
            if not any(m in str(e) for m in ("activity sequence", "No timing results")) or attempt == tries - 1:
                raise

class Kernel:
    def __init__(self, cubin, name):
        torch.zeros(1, device="cuda")                    # make torch's primary context current
        self.ctx = _ok(driver.cuCtxGetCurrent(), "cuCtxGetCurrent")
        self.module = _ok(driver.cuModuleLoadData(cubin), "cuModuleLoadData")
        self.fn = _ok(driver.cuModuleGetFunction(self.module, name.encode()), "cuModuleGetFunction")
        self.name = name

    def set_smem(self, nbytes):
        """Allow more than 48 KB of dynamic shared memory."""
        attr = driver.CUfunction_attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES
        _ok(driver.cuFuncSetAttribute(self.fn, attr, nbytes), "cuFuncSetAttribute")

    def __call__(self, grid, block, *args, smem=0, stream=None):
        _ok(driver.cuCtxSetCurrent(self.ctx), "cuCtxSetCurrent")   # driver contexts are per thread
        vals, types = [], []
        for a in args:
            if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
                vals.append(a.data_ptr()); types.append(ctypes.c_void_p)
            elif isinstance(a, i64):
                vals.append(int(a)); types.append(ctypes.c_int64)
            elif isinstance(a, int):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_int32)
            elif isinstance(a, float):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_float)
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"unsupported launch argument {type(a)}")
        g = tuple(grid) + (1,) * (3 - len(grid))
        b = tuple(block) + (1,) * (3 - len(block))
        s = stream if stream is not None else torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
        _ok(driver.cuLaunchKernel(self.fn, *g, *b, smem, driver.CUstream(s), (tuple(vals), tuple(types)), 0),
            f"cuLaunchKernel({self.name})")

def compile_cubin(src, opts=()):
    """CUDA C++ source -> cubin bytes for sm_100a with NVRTC. Raises with the compile log on error."""
    prog = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcCreateProgram(src.encode(), b"probe.cu", 0, [], []), "nvrtcCreateProgram")
    options = [f"--gpu-architecture={ARCH}".encode(), b"-std=c++17", f"-I{CUDA}/include".encode(),
               *[o.encode() for o in opts]]
    err = nvrtc.nvrtcCompileProgram(prog, len(options), options)[0]
    log_size = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLogSize(prog), "nvrtcGetProgramLogSize")
    log = b" " * log_size
    nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLog(prog, log)
    if int(err) != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("NVRTC compile failed:\n" + log.decode(errors="replace"))
    size = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBINSize(prog), "nvrtcGetCUBINSize")
    cubin = b" " * size
    _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBIN(prog, cubin), "nvrtcGetCUBIN")
    return cubin

src=open("/tmp/r9/tc_steal.cu").read()
src=src.replace("p.nc % p.kbs","kKB % p.kbs")
src=src.replace("namespace {\nconstexpr int kD","__device__ unsigned long long g_dbg[160*4];\nstatic int g_rdiv = 3, g_grid = 0;\nextern \"C\" void set_knobs(int r, int g){ g_rdiv = r; g_grid = g; }\nextern \"C\" void get_dbg(unsigned long long* h){ cudaMemcpyFromSymbol(h, g_dbg, sizeof(unsigned long long)*160*4); }\nnamespace {\nconstexpr int kD",1)
src=src.replace("p.ncOwn = p.nc - p.nc / 3;","p.ncOwn = p.nc - (g_rdiv ? p.nc / g_rdiv : 0);")
src=src.replace("grid = sms > kTiles ? sms : kTiles;","grid = sms > kTiles ? sms : kTiles; if (g_grid) grid = g_grid;")
src=src.replace("tc_steal_kernel<<<grid,","tc_steal_kernel<<<(g_grid ? g_grid : grid),")
# timing debug
src=src.replace("  const uint32_t tmem = tmem_slot;\n\n  if (warp == 0) {","  const uint32_t tmem = tmem_slot;\n  unsigned long long t_start; asm volatile(\"mov.u64 %0, %globaltimer;\":\"=l\"(t_start));\n\n  if (warp == 0) {",1)
src=src.replace("    put(-1, 0, 2);\n","    put(-1, 0, 2);\n    if (lane == 0) { g_dbg[blockIdx.x*4+2] = own; g_dbg[blockIdx.x*4+3] = i - 1 - own; }\n",1)
src=src.replace("  if (threadIdx.x == 0) {   // every access","  if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long t; asm volatile(\"mov.u64 %0, %globaltimer;\":\"=l\"(t)); g_dbg[blockIdx.x*4] = t_start; g_dbg[blockIdx.x*4+1] = t; }\n  if (threadIdx.x == 0) {   // every access",1)
open("/tmp/r9/steal_dbg.cu","w").write(src)
r=subprocess.run("cd /tmp/r9 && nvcc -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC steal_dbg.cu -o steal_dbg.so -lcuda",shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.returncode, r.stderr[-1500:])
L=ctypes.CDLL("/tmp/r9/steal_dbg.so"); S=ctypes.CDLL("/tmp/r9/small.so")
L.adamod_tc_steal.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*5+[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
L.adamod_steal_part_floats.restype=ctypes.c_longlong
S.adamod_tc_small.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*4+[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
W=(torch.randn(18432,3072,device="cuda")/3072**0.5); bias=torch.randn(18432,device="cuda")
def steal(emb,W,bias,*outs):
    B=emb.shape[0]; part=torch.empty(L.adamod_steal_part_floats(B),device="cuda")
    arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    st=L.adamod_tc_steal(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),arr,part.data_ptr(),B,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream); assert st==0,st
def small(emb,W,bias,*outs):
    arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    st=S.adamod_tc_small(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),arr,emb.shape[0],torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream); assert st==0
flush=torch.empty(int(252e6)//4,device="cuda")
B=5
emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device="cuda"); outs=[torch.empty(B,3072,device="cuda") for _ in range(6)]
ref=(emb.double()@W.double().t()+bias.double()).float()
for rdiv,g in [(0,144),(0,148),(3,144),(3,148),(6,148),(12,148)]:
    L.set_knobs(rdiv,g)
    us=bp.harness_time(steal,[emb,W,bias],outs)
    flush.zero_(); torch.cuda.synchronize(); steal(emb,W,bias,*outs); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    err=(torch.cat(outs,1)-ref).abs().max().item()
    h=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*(640))(); L.get_dbg(h); a=np.array(h[:g*4],dtype=np.float64).reshape(g,4)
    t0=a[:,0].min(); st=(a[:,0]-t0)/1e3; en=(a[:,1]-t0)/1e3
    print(f"rdiv{rdiv} g{g}: {us:.2f} us err {err:.1e} | start max {st.max():.2f} end min {en.min():.1f} med {np.median(en):.1f} max {en.max():.1f} | own min {a[:,2].min():.0f} max {a[:,2].max():.0f} steals tot {a[:,3].sum():.0f} max {a[:,3].max():.0f}",flush=True)
print("small", bp.harness_time(small,[emb,W,bias],outs))

src=src.replace("extern \"C\" int adamod_tc_small(","static int g_pd=0, g_pk=0;\nextern \"C\" void set_pf(int d,int k){g_pd=d;g_pk=k;}\nextern \"C\" int adamod_tc_small(")
src=src.replace("int B, int Bpad, int kbs, int stages, int tmem_cols) {","int B, int Bpad, int kbs, int stages, int tmem_cols, int pd, int pk) {")
src=src.replace("(mW, mE, bias, op, B, Bpad, kbs, stages, tmem_cols);","(mW, mE, bias, op, B, Bpad, kbs, stages, tmem_cols, g_pd, g_pk);")
# prefetch: at start issue stages..stages+pd-1 ; then each iteration prefetch i+stages+pd-1
src=src.replace("    for (int i = 0; i < nIt; ++i) { const int s = i % stages;\n      if (i >= stages)",
 "    uint64_t pp; if (pk) asm volatile(\"createpolicy.fractional.L2::evict_last.b64 %0, 1.0;\" : \"=l\"(pp)); else pp = pol;\n"
 "    auto pf = [&](int it){ if (it < nIt) asm volatile(\"cp.async.bulk.prefetch.tensor.3d.L2.global.L2::cache_hint [%0, {%1, %2, %3}], %4;\" :: \"l\"((uint64_t)&mapW), \"r\"(0), \"r\"(m0), \"r\"(it * kbs), \"l\"(pp) : \"memory\"); };\n"
 "    for (int d = 0; d < pd; ++d) pf(stages + d);\n"
 "    for (int i = 0; i < nIt; ++i) { const int s = i % stages;\n      if (pd && i >= stages) pf(i + pd);\n      if (i >= stages)",1)
open("/tmp/r9/pf.cu","w").write(src)
r=subprocess.run("cd /tmp/r9 && nvcc -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC pf.cu -o pf.so -lcuda",shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.returncode, r.stderr[-1500:])
P=ctypes.CDLL("/tmp/r9/pf.so"); P.adamod_tc_small.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*4+[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
W=(torch.randn(18432,3072,device="cuda")/3072**0.5); bias=torch.randn(18432,device="cuda")
def f(emb,W,bias,*outs):
    arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    st=P.adamod_tc_small(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),arr,emb.shape[0],torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream); assert st==0,st
for B in (5,128):
  emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device="cuda"); outs=[torch.empty(B,3072,device="cuda") for _ in range(6)]
  ref=(emb.double()@W.double().t()+bias.double()).float()
  res={}
  for rep in range(2):
    for pd,pk in [(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(4,0),(2,1)]:
      P.set_pf(pd,pk); res.setdefault((pd,pk),[]).append(round(bp.harness_time(f,[emb,W,bias],outs),2))
  P.set_pf(2,0); f(emb,W,bias,*outs); torch.cuda.synchronize(); err=(torch.cat(outs,1)-ref).abs().max().item()
  print(B, res, "err", err, flush=True)
